_note: v4 phase 1, lead, 2026-11-16. Lens events per plate (film-s01; Idi R35: all lens effects yes, on today's tone, no grade). Each has a cause on screen and a short window; the base look returns after it; the meter corner stays clean. Times are song seconds from the room's visual transcript: the builder snaps each to its exact frame. `exists` = already coded in _pa-lens.ts (mode L). Kinds: ca (colour fringing, 2-3 frames), kick (camera jolt), flare (streak from a bright source), bloom, exposure (the eye adapting), focus (depth of field pull), fov (wide-angle bulge or punch), breathe (vignette closing or opening). Traps (each breaks R31): a blurred sung word, constant flare or fringing, bloom on paper, brightness pumping on every beat.
